**Company Description** 




 The Agentic Loop is an AI publication and learning space focused on frontier agentic AI for curious learners, builders, and leaders. It breaks down the latest developments in AI agents, underlying models, and real\-world applications into clear, practical language. Through a weekly newsletter, daily posts, and hands\-on programs like the Production GenAI Engineering Program, The Agentic Loop helps people move from simply following AI trends to building with them. The platform features honest, non\-hyped perspectives on what works, what does not, and conversations with practitioners shaping the agent age. It is designed for students, founders, engineers, and decision\-makers who want to actively engage with the AI shift rather than watch it from the sidelines.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Generative AI Engineer will design, build, and optimize agentic AI systems and tools used across The Agentic Loop’s content, programs, and community. In this full\-time remote role, the engineer will prototype and deploy applications using large language models and related technologies, integrating them into production\-ready workflows. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include experimenting with model architectures and prompting strategies, developing APIs and microservices, and improving reliability, safety, and performance of AI\-driven features. The role also involves collaborating with editorial and education teams to translate AI capabilities into practical demos, learning materials, and frameworks for the audience. The engineer will monitor system behavior, evaluate model outputs, and iterate based on user feedback and emerging research.

 We are building the
 **unmetered intelligence workforce** 
 : autonomous AI agents that do real, end\-to\-end work for enterprises instead of just answering questions. Since founding in 2022 we have gone from research to agents running

 sits at the sharpest edge of it: your work lands in front of real customers in weeks, not quarters, and directly shapes how the world's most demanding enterprises adopt
 **agentic AI** 
 . If you want the shortest possible line between what you build and the outcomes it creates, this is a rare seat.
   

  

 Why This Role Exists
   

  

 When we close a large enterprise deal, the contract is the start of the hard part, not the end.  **Applied AI Engineer** 
 . We attach an Applied AI Engineer to every large enterprise account. They
 **embed with the customer** 
 , build the first high\-value agentic workflows on our platform, and
 **own technical success** 
 from kickoff through go\-live and expansion. The Applied AI Engineer is how a signed contract becomes a renewed and expanded one.
   

  

 What You'll Own
   

  

* Land the deployment. Embed with a newly\-closed enterprise customer, rapidly learn their operations and data, and stand up the first production agent workflows on NinjaTech in weeks, not quarters.
